relevant_passages.quote: **Does the ML work?** Judged on this evidence: affinity v2 is a plausible heuristic but covers too few pairs to serve most traffic; v4 is **not a real ranking model** — `model_scores = affinity_v2 × (1 + 0.1·w₁)` (w₁ = the n_items coefficient), verified exact on all 948 rows, i.e., rank-identical to v2. Flipping the flag to 4.0.0 would change nothing except the version stamp — and that is worth knowing before anyone "ships v4".

-- duplicate-order inflation
WITH dups AS (SELECT payment_ref, MIN(id) keep_id FROM novamart.orders
              GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT COUNTIF(o.status=1) dup_orders, ROUND(SUM(IF(o.status=1,o.price,0)),2) dup_rev
FROM novamart.orders o JOIN dups d
  ON d.payment_ref=o.payment_ref AND o.id!=d.keep_id;
